verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v1: fabī ʾasafu fī ṭayyihi ʾasafāni waḥuznu ʾidhā qaddartahu ḥuzunāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v2: wataḥta mathābi l-wajhi wal-wajhu ʿābisu ḍarīḥāni fī l-ʾiḥsāni yashtarikāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v3: waqad saʾalūnī man humā faʾajabtuhum humā millahu bal ṭīnata ʾabawāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v4: fayā lafaqīdi fī r-riḍā wafaqīdati humā fī l-ʿulā wal-majdi yastabiqāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v5: fahadhā bifaḍli min ladunhu waḥikmahi wahadhī biqalbi mushfiqi waḥanāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v6: faqadnāka niṣfā yā khalīfata māliki waniṣfā faqadnā baʿdu yaltaḥiqāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v7: fakāna bukāʾu n-nāsi min qablu qiṭʿaha mina l-wajdi ʾidh khallafta khayra ʾamāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v8: walakinnahā hiyā l-manūnu takhaṭṭafat karīmataka l-muthlā biqabḍi banāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v9: farāḥat limaʾawāka l-mubāraki dūnahum waḥallat makānā qurba khayri makāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v10: wahā ʾantumā fī l-masjidi l-ʾaqdasi lladhī banāhu r-rijālu sh-shummu dūna tawāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v11: walam yabqa fīhim minkumā ghayru dhimmahi wayā dhimmaha turʿā bikulli janāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v12: walam yabqa ʾillā ṣ-ṣabru wadh-dhikru wasṭahum wayā ḥusna dhikri ṭayyibi bilisāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v13: ṣabīḥata yawmi qad ghadā kullu muslimi bihi yartajī fī llāhi nayla ʾamānī
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v14: ṣabīḥata ʿāshūrāʾa lil-khuldi mawʿidā ghadāta ghadā n-niṣfāni yaltaqiyāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v15: ʿajāʾibu hadhā d-dīni fī baʿḍi ʾahlihi tuʿʿadu yaqīnā ʿindahum bithawāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v16: fabirru waʾīmānu wasirru ʿaqīdati waʿahdu yurāʿī ḥaqqahu fatayāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v17: wamā l-mawtu ʾillā ʾāyatu dūna waṣfihā qiyāsu wadūna l-mawti kullu bayāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v18: ḥijābu lahu bābu ʿalā l-mulki ẓāhiru wabābu warāʾa l-mulki yastawiyāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v19: biʿādu bila sayri l-biʿādi wahijratu bila hijrati fī ḍimnihā ṭarafāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v20: wamin thamma yabdū lil-ḥakīmi kamāluhu wayabdū lahu fī ṭayyihi ʿajabāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v21: walawla khtilafu fī l-ʿibārāti ʾadrakat ʿuqūlu l-warā mā fī khtilafi maʿānī
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v22: walakin jarat fī dhāka lil-hi sunnatu khalat mā khala lil-ha ḥukmu zamāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v23: faqultu waqawlī fī l-qulūbi mushāraku fahimtu wafī kulli mriʾi hayamānī
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v24: ʾala yā ʾilaha l-ʿālamīna biʾasrihim wayā man ʾilā hadhā n-nidāʾi hadānī
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v25: fala tatruki l-bayta lladhī kāna maskanā lihadhayni bal fāḥfaẓhu kulla ʾawāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v26: wakun liʿiyāli d-dīni fīhi muwāliyā waṣunhum ʿani ṭ-ṭughyāni wath-thawarāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v27: wakhudh lahumā mā ṭāba min jannati l-ʿulā wala tajʿali l-mathwā lighayri jināni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v28: maʿa l-muṣṭafā l-mukhtāri min ʾāli hāshimi faʾakrim bihi min murshidi litahanī
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v29: biẓilli ʾabī l-ʿabbāsi quṭbi zamānihi waman huwa lil-ʾaqṭābi shamsu ʿiyāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v30: waṣalli ṣalata tashmulu l-ʾāla kullahum ʿalayhi biʾaʿlā min ṣafāʾi jumāni
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v31: waḥaqqiq rajāʾī fīhimā bimuḥammadi waʾatmim naṣībī wāḥminī bikiyānī
verses.fabi-asafun-fi-tayyihi-asafani-c1-v32: wadhalika mā ʾawlā fatā fī muṣībati fabī ʾasafu fī ṭayyihi ʾasafāni
